name: 12 Play Testers
description: Managed Google Play closed testing for Android apps: 12 human testers on real devices, using the app every day for 14 consecutive days, so a new developer account can apply for production access. Operated by KubeAI. Every order starts as pending authorisation: Yacine Zairi, the accountable human, must authorise it, and the client must confirm the quote, before testers are engaged or payment is arranged. A real person aims to reply within 4h (a target, not a guarantee, 24/7). Today's working intake is the form documented at https://play.kubeai.info/availability.json, or email quotes@kubeai.info.
